Configuration for the [Openprovider](https://www.openprovider.com/) DNS provider.

See the [lego documentation](https://go-acme.github.io/lego/dns/openprovider/) for full details.

```yaml
letsEncrypt:
  dnsProvider: "openprovider"
  dnsCredentials:
    # OPENPROVIDER_PASSWORD: The user's password
    password: ""
    # OPENPROVIDER_USERNAME: The user's name
    username: ""
    # OPENPROVIDER_POLLING_INTERVAL: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 10)
    pollingInterval: ""
    # OPENPROVIDER_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 600)
    propagationTimeout: ""
    # OPENPROVIDER_TTL: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 600)
    ttl: ""
```

Credentials are passed directly to lego using strong types and are never written to the process environment.
You may also use the raw lego environment-variable names as keys instead of the normalized names.
